prerequisites: The second study section must have been reached. At least 42 ECTS credits from the first study section must be demonstrated.

learning_outcomes.text: be able to behave appropriately in everyday situations of professional interaction
reflect on their own communication and team competence and use it more purposefully
develop goal-oriented solutions for dealing with critical situations and conflicts
accept and reflect on criticism of their own person
give fair feedback on the behavior of other people

syllabus_topics: Discussion of expectations, fears, uncertainties, and recommendations for action regarding the upcoming company internship
Reflection of own strengths and weaknesses
Practicing various communication and conflict resolution techniques through group exercises and role plays
Giving constructive feedback to other people
Accepting criticism of one's own person

assessment_methods.method: Attendance and active participation in individual and group exercises as well as role plays (ungraded)

assessment_rules: The assessment is based on participation: 'LN - ohne/mit Erfolg teilgenommen' (successfully/unsuccessfully participated). Attendance and active participation in individual and group exercises as well as role plays are required.
bibliography: GAY, Friedbert, 2004. Das persolog Persönlichkeits-Profil: Persönliche Stärke ist kein Zufall.
